id.description: This is the unique identifier for the provider resource.

orgId.description: This is the unique identifier for the org that this provider resource belongs to.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the provider resource was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the provider resource was last updated.

provider.description: This is the provider that manages this resource.

resourceName.description: This is the name/type of the resource.

resourceId.description: This is the provider-specific identifier for the resource.

resource.description: This is the full resource data from the provider's API.
